# STATE CELL CONTRACT (WQ-131, Will-approved 2026-08-29): lead token + ONE-LINE current state + `· hist→GATES_STATE_HISTORY`, whole cell ≤220 chars. Consumers: status logic (prome_gate · will_brief · will_handbook counts) reads the lead token; the dashboard renders up to 220 chars; will_handbook.py:468 searches the current state text when associating a position with a gate — so a LIVE row that watches a position should NAME its ticker in the one-liner. Full prior cell text lives VERBATIM at PROME/archive/GATES_STATE_HISTORY_2026-08-29.md keyed by gate_id with entry-crc32 (recompute, never trust). Append history there, never in the cell; the cell is current state only.

# MAINTENANCE: PROME owns this file. Register a row the same session a gate is approved; resolve/lapse rows the session their verdict lands. Owners' own KBs stay canonical for full logic — this is the coordination-layer index so a fired gate can never again be orphaned by its owner freezing.

# REGISTRATION JOIN RULE (WQ-86, Will "approve all… with your recs" 2026-09-01; record PROME/proposals/2026-09-01_wq-batch-RULED.md): ① a gate/threshold ratified at a desk is routed to THIS file at fire-time — the OWNER's one-line duty (CORAL MSI-01 went 31 days unregistered); ② a row here naming a NON-SELF owner is UNDELIVERED until that owner has a read-path — the REGISTRAR's duty (VX-BND-18). Each end's own audit passes clean while nobody owns the join; the weekly spine audit reconciles ACROSS it.

# consumed_by AMENDED same night (TERRY A2, forum 06_proposals/08): NONE is reserved for genuinely-no-consumer; condition-triggered gates write PRICE:<expr> (routes to the S9 evaluator registry — its seed list = every PRICE: cell here) or EVENT:<desc> (owner-adjudicated). A1: the date form is the RESOLVER date, never an expiry.

# consumed_by (added 2026-08-07, forum ruling S2/ABN, Will-adopted): <date> | <the decision that consumes the answer> | <decision owner> — or NONE (legitimate, quiet: no dated consumer) — or "— (terminal)". REQUIRED at registration for new rows. The date must be file-readable from the subject own ledger (DOCKET row, publication cadence, expiry) — never a calendar guess (PAT-089 guard). Slack alarms read THIS field; the old >5d raw-age rule is RETIRED by the same ruling.
